#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::cin >> str;

    int insert = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < str.length(); ++i) {
        int count = 1;
        while (i + 1 < str.length() && str[i] == str[i + 1]) {
            ++count;
            ++i;
        }
        if (count % 2 == 0) {
            ++insert;
        }
    }

    std::cout << insert << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
